verified.quote: and capture through a rule (§§2–9). *Claimed*: that these laws explain how a subject goes on, argued from the laws on the models, not a theorem. *Open*: whether every becoming has a faithful representation in the grammar.

Its *Claimed* names only the argued explanatory reading, so the chapter's claim reads as 'not a theorem', though the chapter proves its laws on their bases. 01 ('Claimed: these laws, for every carrier, relation and class or on a named model; that the reading explains ... is argued from them, not proved') and 03 ('Claimed: these laws on their bases, ...') put the laws first. §9 gets only 'capture through a rule'. That is where the map's lock is proved: 元吸引子 defined (l.402), the lock and the lock outliving an unread loss (l.394, l.405), the selection of the capacity to shape the rule joined to the lock at a critical mass (l.388, l.417, l.420), and the window for a late reading (l.423). Under the new AGENTS.md ('first a map for alignment: what a selection ... reaches, ... how it locks on what it already chose') this is the core the opening should name. The opening also leaves out the three theses and their tests. Verifier's changes to the reader's replacement: (1) the definition keeps its last clause, 'nothing in it reading what lies beyond the share' (l.402), which the reader's version dropped; (2) T7's field test of reform events, which could not be frozen (T7F, l.434), is named beside LA2, as T1's refused field tests are, so no failed test is left out for one thesis and kept for another; (3) the theses are said once to go beyond the models as conjectures (T1 Standing 'beyond them conjectured', T2 'conjectured', T7 'That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured'), so the new *Claimed* (laws first) does not read as covering them; (4) '§9 holds the laws of selection' became 'In §9', since selection's reach is 03's law (07 §6 cites 03#r-selection-through-couplings). 'Not a theorem', the Open item, 'without noise' and drift, the refused field tests and LA2 as a counterexample are all kept. Nothing claims an alignment designed. verified.quote: That any class is warranted: constancy says only that a class agrees with 缘, and identity is constant under every relation (`«静有常»`).
verified.why: 'Warranted' is the old rules' vocabulary ('No warrant from outside is sought'). It measures the choice of a class against a warrant standing over the reading. What is there instead: the grammar names the class and does not choose it (§2, l.52: 'The grammar does not choose: it names the class and says everything relative to it'); constancy picks out no class, since identity is constant under every relation; and a class named for a domain is what a measurement or an intervention can defeat (08 §9, l.643). The verifier's change: 08 §9 makes that defeat conditional ('once a relation and a class are named apart from the course'), and the reader's replacement dropped this condition. It is restored here, since a class fitted to the course afterwards is not what the defeater reads. `«静有常»` is kept.
